title: Belief and Evidence: *ezzel szemben*, *mindazonáltal*
grammar: Setting evidence against an old belief
goal: I can set an old belief against the evidence with *szerint … ezzel szemben*, *éppen ellenkezőleg* and *mindazonáltal*.
I can name the ideas of the dispute (*miazma-elmélet*, *statisztikai evidencia*, *orvosi paradigmaváltás*).
I can write one short sentence that contrasts what people believed with what the numbers showed.
